title: Reliability of Claude Code as an Agentic AI Grading System for Handwritten University Exams
abstract: arXiv:2611.13217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines the reliability of Claude Code, an agentic deployment of the Claude Opus 4.6 large language model, as a grading system for handwritten university exams. Four research questions addressed agreement with expert human grading on total scores (RQ1), agreement across five question types from multiple choice to evaluative judgement (RQ2), consistency across two independent grading sessions one week apart (RQ3), and the accuracy of AI-generated feedback (RQ4). Claude Code graded the 20-mark mid-term papers of 60 consenting students in a Saudi computer graphics course in a single agentic session, guided by three rubric files. Reliability was estimated on disjoint samples: 20 papers for RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4, and 15 papers for RQ3. Analyses used Pearson correlation, mean absolute error, Bland-Altman analysis, weighted Cohen kappa, intraclass correlation, and a four-category coding scheme separating diagnostic from confirmation feed

translated_title: Claude Code作为智能体式AI评分系统对手写大学考试的评分可靠性研究
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了Claude Code（Claude Opus 4.6大型语言模型的一种智能体式部署）作为手写大学考试评分系统的可靠性。研究围绕四个问题展开：与专家人工评分在总分上的一致性（RQ1）、在从选择题到评价性判断共五种题型上的一致性（RQ2）、在一周间隔的两次独立评分会话中的稳定性（RQ3），以及AI生成反馈的准确性（RQ4）。在三个评分量规文件的引导下，Claude Code在单个智能体会话中批改了沙特一所计算机图形学课程中60名同意参与学生的20分制期中试卷。可靠性在互不重叠的样本上进行估计：RQ1、RQ2和RQ4使用20份试卷，RQ3使用15份试卷。分析采用了皮尔逊相关系数、平均绝对误差、Bland-Altman分析、加权Cohen kappa、组内相关系数，以及一套区分诊断性反馈与确认性反馈的四类编码方案。
tldr: 本研究首次系统评估了基于Claude Opus 4.6的智能体式系统Claude Code对手写大学考试评分的可靠性，考察其与专家人工评分在总分及五种题型上的一致性、跨会话的稳定性以及AI反馈的准确性。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates the reliability of Claude Code, an agentic AI grading system built on Claude Opus 4.6, for grading handwritten university exams, examining its agreement with expert human grading across five question types, consistency across independent grading sessions, and the accuracy of AI-generated feedback.
